subject.title: [Bug]: Ctrl+C not working in Windows install on foreground

question: Should this issue wait for native Windows npm-global Ctrl+C reproduction before a new repair PR is queued?
rationale: Current source already handles delivered SIGINT, so a safe fix location depends on proving whether Ctrl+C fails to reach Node or the gateway fails after delivery.

options.title: Require Windows live repro
options.body: Keep the issue open for validation in PowerShell, cmd.exe, and Windows Terminal before repair work starts.

options.title: Queue after delivery proof
options.body: If live proof confirms Ctrl+C is not delivered to the foreground process, queue a narrow signal/key handling fix with cleanup tests.

recommendation.title: Require Windows live repro
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open for validation in PowerShell, cmd.exe, and Windows Terminal before repair work starts.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is gateway CLI lifecycle and docs work near the affected foreground command path.
